name: Font Color
what_it_does: Sets the color of the selected text; the dropdown opens a color picker (theme/standard/more).
behavior: Opens subfeature:font-color-picker (dropdown). Contents (6 controls): Font Color, High-contrast only, Automatic, More Colors..., Gradient, Color swatches. Sub-surfaces: ui:font-color-dropdown-more-colors. [the subfeature:font-color-picker flyout — items are endpoints; swatches pixel-sampled; sections: Gallery Filters, Standard Colors, Theme Colors] Appears as a capital 'A' with a red bar beneath it and a dropdown chevron.

connections.why: all apply a color (text / highlight / fill) to the selection
